_meta.title: 2 Timothy — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 4 chapters of 2 Timothy. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 55 2 Timothy); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-2, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.plain: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.visual_prompt: a quiet stone courtyard archway opening onto the hills in a bronze athlete's wreath resting beside a finished track

verses.text: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.plain: That is why I suffer as I do. Yet I am not ashamed, because I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.
verses.visual_prompt: a gnarled fig tree casting open contour lines across rocky ground in a bronze athlete's wreath resting beside a finished track

verses.text: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.plain: Endure hardship with us like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.visual_prompt: a weathered dry-stone boundary wall and wild olive branch in a parchment scroll case and reed pen resting on a rough stone table

verses.text: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.plain: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.
verses.visual_prompt: two inscribed stone tablets resting beside an olive branch on a rough ledge in a bronze athlete's wreath resting beside a finished track

verses.text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.plain: All scripture is God-breathed and useful for teaching, for rebuking, for correcting, and for training in righteousness,
verses.visual_prompt: a gnarled fig tree casting open contour lines across rocky ground in a bronze athlete's wreath resting beside a finished track near an unquenched oil lamp burning steady in a stone niche (2 timothy 3:16 motif: scripture)

verses.text: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
verses.plain: so that the person of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
verses.visual_prompt: a rough-hewn limestone bench overlooking a quiet valley in an unquenched oil lamp burning steady in a stone niche

verses.text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.plain: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verses.visual_prompt: a solitary robed watchman seen from the back standing on a stone rampart overlooking a parchment scroll case and reed pen resting on a rough stone table
